The main takeaway from our work is that
tyranny is not a matter of the “banality of the evil” but the evil of banality: the banality of a psychology that is not just ordinary but also deeply disturbing.
understanding extreme action is not a question of “nature or nurture,” but of the interaction between individual and situation.
understanding the psychology of tyranny is not a matter of understanding the situation or understanding the person but understanding the interaction between the two.
